violation_type.code_system: Texas Administrative Code, Title 26, Ch. HRC42
violation_type.title: HRC42.056(g) - BGC-persons cannot provide direct care/have direct access to children without all required background checks unless they meet certain criteria. (26 TAC §HRC42.056(g) - BGC-persons cannot provid)
violation_type.short_title: HRC42.056(g) - BGC-persons cannot provide direct care/have direct access to children without all required background checks unless they meet certain criteria.
violation_type.typical_finding: A caregiver at the operation did not have the correct background check to be left alone with children unsupervised or be counted in ratio.

finding_variants.text: A caregiver at the operation did not have the correct background check to be left alone with children unsupervised or be counted in ratio.
A staff who was engaged in play with infants in the 0-12 month old classroom was without a background check.
